securityProtocol.vaultEngine: AES-256-GCM + scrypt (N: 16384, r: 8, p: 1) + zlib Gzip Level 9
securityProtocol.headerFormat: DWNXVALT (8B) + Version (1B) + Attempts (1B) + Salt (32B) + IV (12B) + AuthTag (16B) + Ciphertext

hackerDefenseLifecycle.attempt1: Logs warning, marks in-header attempt byte to 1, sets .vault_attempts sidecar
hackerDefenseLifecycle.attempt2: Permanently scrambles local vault file on disk with crypto.randomBytes(fileSize)
hackerDefenseLifecycle.recovery: Successful unpack resets attempts to 0 and removes sidecar

securityProtocol.zeroPlainSecretsRule: Never commit unencrypted .env.local, .tauri/*.key, or reference/ to version control.
securityProtocol.gitPushPermissionRule: NEVER execute git push, publish branches, or push tags to remote repositories without explicit user permission.
securityProtocol.reaDefinitionRule: When the user writes 'REA' in all-caps, it strictly means Reverse Engineering / Reverse Engineer Anything (morluto/rea, rea-agents), NEVER React.
